mapper.sql: id, symbol, market, status, entry_price, entry_qty, entry_at, range_low_at_entry, range_high_at_entry, budget_allocated, exit_price, exit_reason, exit_at, dry_run, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM range_trade_position WHERE status = 'HOLDING' ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM range_trade_position ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM range_trade_position WHERE status = 'HOLDING'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM((exit_price - entry_price) * entry_qty), 0) FROM range_trade_position WHERE status = 'EXITED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM range_trade_position WHERE status = 'EXITED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM range_trade_position WHERE status = 'EXITED' AND exit_price > entry_price
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM range_trade_position WHERE status = 'EXITED' AND exit_price < entry_price

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( COALESCE((SELECT COALESCE(buy_log.commission, 0) + COALESCE(buy_log.tax, 0) FROM range_trade_order_log buy_log WHERE buy_log.symbol = p.symbol AND buy_log.side = 'BUY' AND buy_log.success = 1 AND buy_log.created_at <= p.entry_at ORDER BY buy_log.created_at DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COALESCE(sell_log.commission, 0) + COALESCE(sell_log.tax, 0) FROM range_trade_order_log sell_log WHERE sell_log.symbol = p.symbol AND sell_log.side = 'SELL' AND sell_log.success = 1 AND sell_log.created_at <= p.exit_at ORDER BY sell_log.created_at DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY), 0) ), 0) FROM range_trade_position p WHERE p.status = 'EXITED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO range_trade_position (symbol, market, status, entry_price, entry_qty, entry_at, range_low_at_entry, range_high_at_entry, budget_allocated, dry_run, created_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, 'HOLDING', #{entryPrice}, #{entryQty}, #{entryAt}, #{rangeLowAtEntry}, #{rangeHighAtEntry}, #{budgetAllocated}, #{dryRun}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
